3\. Buzz instructions can start a second lead 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
The revised LEAD-SILENT instructions say the architect may start the takeover itself or give
Matthew a takeover line, but the next step tells Matthew to start a lead unconditionally. If the
architect already fired the task, following both steps can launch another takeover instead of
stopping after the first start.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The buzz procedure offers an architect-started takeover but then directs Matthew to start another one regardless. ## Fix Focus Areas - docs/manual/answer-a-buzz.md[98-101] ## Recommended Fix Make the final start step conditional on receiving a takeover line. If the architect starts the lead, direct Matthew to wait for that lead instead. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
